_about: Sources read 2 October 2026 for the Korean War records of the war memorial sourcing (Nathan: 'Move on to Korea, Vietnam and the War on Terror first ... the other conflicts have better-indexed federal sources'). NARA AAD, read in a browser: the Korean Conflict Casualty File (RG 330, all services) and the Korean War Casualty File (RG 407, Army; serials carry their RA/US/ER prefix there), and the WWII Army enlistment records for Montenegro, who also served in that war.
